You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-cloudflare-r2-digital-21|everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-16. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional payment platforms often charge exorbitant fees that erode your profits. For example, Gumroad takes 10% on every sale, which means if you sell an ebook for $97, you lose $9.70 per transaction. In contrast, with NOWPayments, you only pay a 0.5% fee, retaining more of your earnings. This difference becomes significant as your sales volume increases; at 100 sales per month, you would retain an additional $921. By using sovereign infrastructure, you not only save money but also protect yourself from platform restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your infrastructure, you'll require a few essential components. First, choose a platform for hosting your store, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — both are free. Next, set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle your payment processing and delivery automation. You also need a reliable storage solution for orders, like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery service such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments for seamless Bitcoin transactions, ensuring you can accept payments in cryptocurrency without KYC and wallet requirements.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your infrastructure components ready, it’s time to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by setting up NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions. Create a merchant account, and follow their integration guide to connect it with your backend logic. Next, automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to trigger file access upon payment confirmation. This ensures that your customers receive their ebooks instantly after a successful transaction. Test the entire flow to verify that payments are processed accurately and products are delivered as expected.
Save 9.5% on every sale compared to traditional platforms with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it’s time to launch your store. Ensure that your website is live and accessible. Begin by processing a test transaction to confirm that everything functions correctly. Monitor the transaction closely, checking that payment is received via NOWPayments and that the delivery automation works seamlessly. After confirming the process, promote your ebook through social media or your existing channels. This will help attract your first customers, allowing you to experience the benefits of your sovereign infrastructure firsthand.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Evaluate sales data to identify trends and customer preferences. Expand your product offerings by adding more ebooks or digital assets. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for scaling your infrastructure. Consider integrating additional cryptocurrencies into your payment options using NOWPayments. By continuously optimizing your store and expanding your product range, you can capitalize on your established infrastructure and maximize your revenue potential.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your ebook delivery, ensuring customers receive instant access after payment.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you want to dive deeper into building a complete digital commerce system, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides all the blueprints and templates you need to create a fully operational store that can scale with your business. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

To set up NOWPayments, create a merchant account on their platform. Follow the integration guide to link it with your backend systems, ensuring that you can process Bitcoin payments directly.

You can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. These platforms are free and provide reliable services to host your ebook store without incurring high costs.
How can I automate the delivery of my ebooks?
Automate ebook delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Set these tools to trigger file access once a payment is confirmed, ensuring instant delivery to your customers.
Can I scale my operations easily after deployment?

Yes, once your infrastructure is running, you can easily scale by adding more products or integrating additional cryptocurrencies. The Complete Builder Kit provides the necessary blueprints to support your growth.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on transactions, significantly lower than many traditional platforms. This allows you to retain more of your earnings on each sale.
